scope: Authored event frames and reviewed question forms, not unrestricted Arabic. Freeze this design before fitting.
test_questions: Both installed question forms for each of instrument, condition, joint, occurrence. No fitting on these exact strings.
gold: Manually authored role and polarity per cue. Oracle status and sufficient support sets evaluated independently. Bare external occurrence remains open.
model: Frozen NABT byte GRU, mean-pooled occurrence boundary vectors from question and cue separately. Two ridge heads, lambda=0.1, class-balanced training rows; fixed seed-free closed-form. Exact question and cue inventories held in the source owner. No rank tuning on test.
ranking: First cue only; all candidate cues retained. Break ties by original occurrence. Count top-1 for questions with explicit relevant cues. Separately report when a single cue is a complete minimal support.
comparison: complete checked owner and decoded answer
